restaurant_name: Nicha Clinic Pattaya - Aesthetic & Wellness Beauty Clinic - ณิชาคลินิกพัทยา
text:
I’m visiting Pattaya as a tourist and decided to try a skin treatment while I was here. After some research I chose Nicha Clinic, and I’m very happy with my decision.
The clinic is very clean, modern, and professional. The staff are friendly and make you feel comfortable from the moment you arrive. What I really appreciated is that the clinic works with international clients — they speak not only Thai but also English and Russian, which makes communication very easy for tourists.
There is also a wonderful staff member named Mila who helps with translation and communication for foreign visitors. She was very kind, professional, and made sure I understood every step of the treatment.
I had RF microneedling done on my face, and the procedure was explained in detail before it started. The treatment was done carefully and professionally, and the team made sure I was comfortable the whole time.
A few days later I came back for a follow-up session with ultrasound and a vitamin serum to support the recovery of my skin. I really appreciated their attention to aftercare and skin healing.
The results are already noticeable — my skin feels smoother, fresher, and healthier. I’m very happy with the experience.
If you are visiting Pattaya and looking for a trustworthy aesthetic clinic with professional staff and great service for international clients, I highly recommend Nicha Clinic.
